facts.drive_time_note: free-flow minimum, no congestion, from 74 sample points in Summerland

briefing.summary: As of Saturday August 8, 3:00 AM, the Bald Range wildfire near Summerland, British Columbia has been tracked for 10.2 hours with 1250 satellite fire detections so far. Approximately 1080 residents are estimated to be cut off from all exits, affecting 278 road segments including Okanagan Highway, Princeton-Summerland Road, Garnet Valley Road, Bathville Road, and Cartwright Avenue. Estimated minimum drive times range from an average sample of 14.1 minutes to a longest sample of 21.2 minutes.
pets: Pack enough pet food and water
caveats: These are illustrative estimates from public data, satellite fire detections, OpenStreetMap roads, and modelled population, not official guidance.
Drive times are estimated minimums with no congestion.
Rely on the BC Wildfire Service, EmergencyInfoBC, and local evacuation orders for real decisions.
